def LonelyRunner.SharperInclusivePrimitiveFiniteFamily : ℕ → Prop :=
fun m =>
  ∀ (s : Fin (m + 2) → ℕ),
    StrictMono s →
      s 0 = 0 →
        Finset.univ.gcd s = 1 →
          s (Fin.last (m + 1)) ≤ (m + 2).choose 2 ^ m →
            ∀ (r : Fin (m + 2)), ∃ t, LonelyRunner.LonelyAt (fun i => ↑(s i)) r t
def LonelyRunner.AllSharperInclusivePrimitiveFiniteFamilies : Prop :=
∀ (m : ℕ), 1 ≤ m → LonelyRunner.SharperInclusivePrimitiveFiniteFamily m
